resources.string: Open YouTube or YouTube Music and sign in on the official website. Both open in the same browser, so you can use the same Google account. Switch accounts or sign out from the website.
This sign-in applies to the browser websites. Telos playback continues without an account; your subscriptions, playlists and recommendations are not synced into Telos.
No compatible browser is available. Install or enable a browser that supports Custom Tabs.
